name: wtf
description: /wtf sums up where this session stands and what the agent needs from you, in a few plain lines from Haiku, so you can return to a session without rereading it. The agent keeps working

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the /wtf answer. English and Portuguese have full tables. Any other language gets the answer and its labels translated by the model, and the fixed messages in English

pane.title: Pane
pane.description: Also open the answer in a pane with a re-run key. Off, the answer shows once, in the transcript
